Texts.LongWelcomeMessage: Welcome to the application. This is a startup project based on the ABP framework. For more information visit
Texts.NewsletterInfo: Get information about the latest happenings.
Texts.TwoFactorEnabledDescription: Your account is protected with two-factor authentication.
Texts.TwoFactorDisabledDescription: Enable two-factor authentication to increase the security of your account.
Texts.ScanQRCodeDescription: Scan the QR code below with your authenticator app (e.g., Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator).
Texts.RecoveryCodesDescription: Save these codes in a safe place. You can use them to log in if you lose access to your authenticator app.
Texts.TwoFactorEnabledSuccessfully: Two-factor authentication has been enabled successfully.
Texts.TwoFactorDisabledSuccessfully: Two-factor authentication has been disabled successfully.
Texts.TwoFactorDescription: Two-factor authentication adds a second step to confirm that you are truly logging in. You won't need to do this on devices known to us.
Texts.ChooseIdentityVerification: Choose how to confirm your identity
Texts.AuthenticatorAppDescription: Get a code from an app, such as Google Duo Mobile or Google Authenticator.
Texts.ConfirmPasswordDescription: Please enter your password to continue
Texts.FeatureNotAvailable: This feature is currently not available.
Texts.UseRecoveryCodeLink: Lost your device? Use a recovery code
Texts.VerificationCodeSent: Verification code has been sent to your phone.
Texts.PhoneVerificationDescription: Enter your phone number below to receive a verification code via SMS or WhatsApp.
Texts.TwilioPermissionHint: Note: Make sure to enable SMS permissions for your region (e.g., Palestine) in the Twilio Console settings.
Texts.EmailDescription: We'll send you a code to your email address.
Texts.EmailVerificationDescription: Enter the verification code sent to your email address.
